parameters.query: INSERT INTO contacts (email, first_name, last_name, phone, source, lead_status) VALUES ('{{ $json.email }}', '{{ $json.first_name }}', '{{ $json.last_name }}', '{{ $json.phone }}', '{{ $json.source }}', 'customer') ON CONFLICT (email) DO UPDATE SET lead_status = 'customer', updated_at = NOW() RETURNING id; INSERT INTO lead_activities (contact_id, activity_type, activity_data, score_impact) SELECT id, 'purchase', '{{ JSON.stringify({order_id: $json.order_id, total: $json.total, items: $json.items.length, currency: $json.currency}) }}'::jsonb, 25 FROM contacts WHERE email = '{{ $json.email }}'; UPDATE contacts SET lead_score = LEAST(100, lead_score + 25) WHERE email = '{{ $json.email }}';

INSERT INTO lead_activities (contact_id, activity_type, activity_data, score_impact) SELECT c.id, 'cart_abandoned', '{{ JSON.stringify({total: $json.cart_total, items: $json.items.length, cart_url: $json.cart_url}) }}'::jsonb, 8 FROM contacts c WHERE c.email = '{{ $json.email }}' LIMIT 1;
